The '''Veq-Headley Battery''' was a subdivision of the [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] training exam, skewed precisely to indicate underlying mental trauma or difficulties. [[Jareth Sartoris]] was scored on this, with possible references to an unstable mental condition.
